lines: A dead man won a fucking horse race. Sit your ass down.
In 1923, a jockey died in the middle of a race, and his horse still won.
Dead as shit, and he still beat every living bastard out there.
Rats laugh when you tickle them, just too high for your ears to hear.
Scientists got paid to tickle rats. Goddamn dream job.
There's a town in Norway called Hell, and it freezes over every winter.
So when hell freezes over? That's January, bitch.
Your stomach lining replaces itself every few days so the acid doesn't eat it.
Your own gut is trying to digest your ass. Sleep tight.
So how did a dead man win a race? Comment, dumbass.
